about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Numbing Chilli Bean Tofu with Pork over Rice
recipes.summary: Silken tofu in a numbing chilli bean gravy with pork mince, served over rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Fry the pork in the oil over high heat for 4 minutes until browned and cooked through at 75°C, then add the doubanjiang, garlic, ginger and peppercorn and stir until fragrant.
Pour in the stock and soy sauce, add the tofu and simmer gently for 5 minutes until hot.
Stir the cornflour with a little water and add until the gravy thickens and turns glossy. Scatter with spring onion and serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince to 75°C with no pink.

recipes.title: Cantonese Steamed Chicken with Ginger and Shiitake
recipes.summary: Tender chicken pieces steamed with shiitake and ginger, gluten free with tamari.
steps: Toss the chicken with the tamari, wine, sesame oil, cornflour, ginger and mushrooms.
Spread on a heatproof plate and steam over simmering water for 20 minutes until the chicken is opaque and reaches 75°C.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then serve the chicken and its juices over rice with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C throughout with no pink.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Pork Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Sticky glazed pork slices with garlic and sesame over rice.
steps: Mix the honey, soy sauce and garlic.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, and steam the broccoli for 4 minutes until bright green.
Sear the pork in the oil for 4 minutes until browned, add the glaze and cook until sticky and the pork reaches 70°C.
Serve over rice with broccoli and sesame seed.
notes: Food safety: cook fresh pork to 70°C with no pink remaining.

recipes.title: Tofu and Mushroom Vegan Lunch Pot
recipes.summary: Braised tofu and mushrooms with soy and ginger over rice, vegan.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 6 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Cook the mushrooms and ginger for 5 minutes until browned, then return the tofu with the soy sauce and 1/4 cup water and simmer until reduced.
Finish with sesame oil and spring onion and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Okinawan Sweet Potato Rice Pot
recipes.summary: Rice cooked with purple-fleshed style sweet potato and kombu, savoury and gently sweet.
steps: Rinse the rice and place in a pot with the water, kombu, soy sauce, mirin and potato.
Bring to the boil, cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes until the rice is tender and the potato soft.
Rest, covered, for 10 minutes until fluffy, then stir and scatter with sesame seed.

recipes.title: Goya-Free Okinawan Pork and Tofu Champuru
recipes.summary: Stir-fried pork, firm tofu, cabbage and egg Okinawa style.
steps: Fry the pork in the oil 4 minutes until browned and cooked through to 70°C.
Add the cabbage and crumbled tofu and stir-fry for 4 minutes until wilted.
Pour in the beaten eggs and soy sauce and stir until set, then top with the bonito flakes.
notes: Food safety: cook fresh pork to 70°C and cook the egg until set.

recipes.title: Hokkaido Butter Corn Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Sweet corn and butter over rice with soy and spring onion.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Melt the butter in a pan and fry the corn 5 minutes until lightly golden.
Stir in the soy sauce and pepper, spoon over the rice and top with spring onion.

recipes.title: Salmon Teriyaki Tray Bake with Rice
recipes.summary: Glazed salmon with broccoli roasted together, served with rice.
steps: Toss the broccoli in the oil on a large tray and bake at 200°C for 8 minutes until beginning to colour.
Add the salmon brushed with the teriyaki sauce and bake 10 minutes until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy and serve with sesame seed.
notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked when opaque and flaking, or 63°C.

recipes.title: Jeju Style Braised Pork and Radish Rice Pot
recipes.summary: Pork belly and radish simmered in soy and ginger until tender.
steps: Simmer the pork in water for 10 minutes and drain.
Return to the pot with the daikon, soy sauce, sugar, ginger, garlic and fresh water.
Cover and simmer 45 minutes until the pork is tender and has passed 70°C inside.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy and serve with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook fresh pork to 70°C.

recipes.title: Dakgalbi Spicy Chicken Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Chicken thigh with gochujang, sweet potato and cabbage stir-fried together.
steps: Mix the gochujang, soy, honey and garlic and coat the chicken.
Fry the sweet potato in the oil 6 minutes until starting to soften.
Add the chicken and cabbage and cook 10 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C and the sweet potato is tender.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy and serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C throughout.

recipes.title: Gochujang Tofu Lunch Wraps
recipes.summary: Crisp tofu with gochujang glaze, kimchi and cucumber in flour tortillas, vegan.
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil 7 minutes until golden.
Toss with gochujang and maple syrup for 1 minute until sticky.
Warm the tortillas until pliable and fill with tofu, kimchi and cucumber.

recipes.title: Isan Grilled Chicken with Sticky Rice
recipes.summary: Marinated grilled chicken thighs with lemongrass and garlic over sticky rice, gluten free.
steps: Blend the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar, tamari and pepper and coat the chicken.
Soak the rice 30 minutes, then steam 25 minutes until tender and chewy.
Grill the chicken 12 minutes each side until charred and 75°C.
Serve with the sticky rice.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C throughout.
Plus 1 hour marinating.

recipes.title: Cashew Tofu with Capsicum over Jasmine Rice
recipes.summary: Crisp tofu, capsicum and cashews in a sweet-savoury sauce, vegan.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Fry the tofu in the oil 6 minutes until golden, add garlic and capsicum and cook until crisp-tender.
Add the soy, sugar and cashews and toss until glossy.
Spoon the glossy tofu and cashews over the rice and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Hue Style Lemongrass Beef Noodle Bowls
recipes.summary: Beef strips with lemongrass, chilli and noodles.
steps: Cook the vermicelli per the packet until tender and drain.
Marinate the beef in lemongrass, chilli, fish sauce, sugar.
Sear in the oil 2 minutes until browned and 63°C inside.
Serve over noodles with sprouts and mint.
notes: Food safety: cook beef to at least 63°C.
Plus 20 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Ginger Tofu Banh Mi Baguettes
recipes.summary: Crisp ginger soy tofu in baguette with pickled carrot, vegan.
steps: Marinate the tofu in soy and ginger.
Fry in the oil until golden, 3 minutes a side.
Toss the carrot in the vinegar until softened.
Fill the baguette with tofu, carrot, cucumber and coriander.

recipes.title: Javanese Sweet Soy Chicken Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Chicken thigh braised in kecap manis and garlic.
steps: Fry shallot, garlic and ginger in oil 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add chicken and brown 5 minutes.
Add kecap manis and 1/2 cup water, cover and simmer 15 minutes until chicken reaches 75°C.
Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy and serve with cucumber.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C.

recipes.title: Sambal Egg Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Boiled eggs coated in sambal and tomato over rice.
steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until firm, peel.
Fry garlic and tomato in oil 3 minutes until soft, add sambal.
Add eggs and coat for 2 minutes until sticky.
Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, serve together.
notes: Food safety: boil eggs until firm.

recipes.title: Sabah Style Fish Curry with Okra
recipes.summary: Tangy chilli fish curry with okra and tomato, gluten free.
steps: Fry onion, garlic and ginger in oil 5 minutes.
Add chilli powder, tomato, tamarind paste, and 1 cup water and simmer 8 minutes until thick.
Add okra and fish and simmer 6 minutes until fish is opaque and flakes.
Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy and serve.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flaking.

recipes.title: Malaysian Coconut Egg Breakfast Bowls
recipes.summary: Soft-boiled eggs with coconut rice and sambal.
steps: Cook the rice with the coconut milk and 1/2 cup water until tender and fluffy.
Boil the eggs for 6 minutes then cool and peel.
Serve rice topped with eggs, sambal, cucumber, peanuts.
notes: Food safety: use fresh eggs.

recipes.title: Kerala Style Coconut Prawn Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Prawns with curry leaf, coconut and black pepper, gluten free.
steps: Fry onion in coconut oil 5 minutes until golden.
Add curry leaf, turmeric, pepper and prawns and cook 4 minutes until opaque and pink.
Add desiccated coconut and toss.
Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until opaque and pink throughout.

recipes.title: Punjabi Chole Bhature-Style Chickpea Plates
recipes.summary: Spiced chickpeas with puffed fried breads, vegan.
steps: Knead flour, water, salt into a dough and rest 20 minutes.
Fry onion in oil 6 minutes until golden, add paste, spice and tomato and cook 6 minutes.
Add chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Roll breads and fry in hot oil until puffed and golden.
notes: Plus 20 minutes resting.

recipes.title: Mushroom Matar Lunch Curry with Roti
recipes.summary: Mushrooms and peas in a spiced tomato base, vegan.
steps: Fry onion 5 minutes until golden.
Add paste and tomato and cook until jammy.
Add mushrooms and peas, simmer 8 minutes until tender.
Warm the roti in a dry pan until soft and serve with the curry.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Black Pork Curry
recipes.summary: Dark roasted spice pork shoulder curry with tamarind, gluten free.
steps: Dry-roast curry powder, coriander and pepper in a pan until dark brown and aromatic.
Brown the pork in oil, add onion, garlic and ginger and cook until soft.
Add spices, tamarind, cinnamon and 2 cups water, cover and simmer 80 minutes until pork is tender and 70°C.
Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook fresh pork to 70°C or above.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Egg Roti Lunch Pockets
recipes.summary: Spiced egg and onion pockets in roti.
steps: Fry onion and chilli in oil 4 minutes until soft.
Add curry powder and beaten egg and stir until set.
Warm roti, fill and fold.
notes: Food safety: cook egg until set.

recipes.title: Berbere-Style Spiced Chicken Flatbread Rolls
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken stewed with eggs, rolled in flatbread.
steps: Cook onion in dry pan 8 minutes until soft, add butter and spices.
Add chicken and 1/2 cup water and simmer 20 minutes until 75°C.
Add boiled peeled eggs and heat through until hot.
Warm the flatbread and spoon in the chicken and egg, then roll up to serve.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C and boil eggs until firm.

recipes.title: Kenyan Beef Samosa Plates
recipes.summary: Crisp beef mince triangles with tomato and cucumber.
steps: Cook onion, mince, curry until 75°C and browned.
Fill and fold wrappers into triangles.
Fry in oil 3 minutes a side until crisp.
Serve with tomato and cucumber.
notes: Food safety: cook beef mince to 75°C.

recipes.title: Tanzanian Coconut Bean Stew
recipes.summary: Kidney beans in coconut milk and tomato, vegan, gluten free.
steps: Fry onion and garlic until soft.
Add tomato and curry powder and cook until thick.
Add beans and coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes until creamy.
Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.

recipes.title: Ugandan Chapati Egg Rolls
recipes.summary: Egg omelettes rolled in roti with tomato.
steps: Beat eggs with tomato and spring onion.
Cook in oil in thin layers until set.
Warm the roti in a dry pan until soft, then roll each around an omelette.
notes: Food safety: cook egg until firm.

recipes.title: Maize Pap Bowls with Curried Tomato Onion
recipes.summary: Maize pap with spiced tomato and onion, vegan.
steps: Boil water and whisk in polenta, cook on low until thick, 15 minutes.
Fry onion in oil until soft.
Add tomato and curry powder, simmer until thick.
Spoon the thick tomato mixture over bowls of the hot pap and serve.

recipes.title: Curried Apricot Chicken Skewers on Basmati
recipes.summary: Curried chicken skewers with apricot, gluten free.
steps: Mix chicken with curry powder, jam, oil, thread on skewers.
Grill 15 minutes until 75°C and charred.
Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Slide the chicken off the skewers or serve them whole on top of the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C.

recipes.title: Bunny Chow Bean Curry Loaf
recipes.summary: Hollowed bread filled with spiced bean curry, vegan.
steps: Fry onion until golden, add curry powder.
Add tomato, beans, potato and 1 cup water and simmer 20 minutes until tender.
Hollow bread, fill with curry.

recipes.title: Ube-Free Purple Sweet Potato Rice Pancakes
recipes.summary: Rice flour pancakes with sweet potato mash.
steps: Boil and mash sweet potato until smooth.
Mix with flour, coconut milk, egg, sugar.
Cook in coconut oil until golden each side.
notes: Food safety: cook until set.

recipes.title: Filipino Beef Tapa Lunch Wraps
recipes.summary: Garlic soy beef strips with tomato in tortillas.
steps: Marinate beef in soy, garlic, sugar.
Sear in oil until browned and 63°C.
Fill tortillas with tomato.
notes: Food safety: cook beef to 63°C.

recipes.title: Vegan Pancit Lunch Noodles
recipes.summary: Egg-free noodles stir-fried with cabbage, carrot and soy, vegan.
steps: Cook noodles until tender, drain.
Fry garlic, carrot, cabbage until crisp-tender.
Toss noodles and soy until hot.
Divide into bowls and serve hot with wedges of lime on the side.

recipes.title: Pacific Taro-Free Cassava Coconut Dumpling Plates
recipes.summary: Grated cassava flour dumplings in coconut milk, vegan, gluten free.
steps: Mix flour, coconut milk, salt into dough.
Shape into balls and boil 10 minutes until floating.
Fry the boiled dumplings in the coconut oil until golden on both sides.
Serve warm with sliced fresh tomato on the side.

recipes.title: Baked Lime Coconut Fish Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Fish baked in coconut milk with lime, gluten free.
steps: Layer fish, onion, tomato in dish.
Pour coconut milk and lime, bake at 190°C 15 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
notes: Food safety: cook until opaque and flaking.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Pineapple Tofu Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Glazed tofu and pineapple over rice, vegan.
steps: Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 6 minutes until golden on all sides.
Add pineapple and teriyaki until sticky.
Spoon the sticky tofu and pineapple over the rice and serve hot.

recipes.title: Samoan Style Coconut Chicken Parcels
recipes.summary: Chicken in coconut and spinach in foil, gluten free.
steps: Mix chicken, coconut, spinach, onion, salt.
Divide among four large squares of foil and fold into sealed parcels.
Bake at 200°C 30 minutes until chicken reaches 75°C.
notes: Food safety: cook chicken to 75°C.

recipes.title: Tongan Style Corned Beef Rice Pans
recipes.summary: Corned beef with onion and tomato over rice.
steps: Cook rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Add tomato and corned beef, cook until hot.
Spoon the hot corned beef mixture over the rice and serve.
